title: Reidemeister-torsion holomorphic volume in trace coordinates for good SL2 complex representations of free groups off the specified critical locus
author: Michael Heusener; Joan Porti
work: Holomorphic volume forms on representation varieties of surfaces with boundary
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue 3 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.35
difficulty_reason: The authors combine twisted-cohomology torsion duality with regular peripheral volume forms, compute a four-holed-surface Goldman bracket via bending, and use a branched trace discriminant and Mayer–Vietoris torsion product to derive the higher-rank free-group volume formula. This representation-variety geometry is beyond ordinary qualifying examinations.
